name: Riptide Attack
prerequisites: Improved Drag, Improved Trip, worshiper of Gozreh
benefit:
Whenever you succeed at a trip combat maneuver, you can automatically attempt a drag combat maneuver against your tripped target as a swift action.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 25
By spending 4 stamina points, you can attempt a drag combat maneuver check against any opponent that you successfully trip using Riptide Attack as a free action instead of a swift action.
flavor: You can immediately drag opponents you successfully trip.
